title: Landing trip, flustered, asks for person
persona: Omar Haddad, 40s, from Dallas, hurried and stressed, interrupts himself.
goal: Book an airport pickup, then ask for a person because his flight changed.
opening_line: Yeah hi, I'm landing in Dallas tonight and need a driver.

turns.caller: Going to the Omni hotel downtown.
Wait, my flight might change. Can I talk to a real person?

branches.if_agent: asks to confirm the current flight anyway
branches.caller: No no, just get me a person.

turns.caller: Somebody who can change it if the flight moves.
Two people, one bag, whatever. Just tell them.
Is that gonna reach them tonight, or tomorrow?

curveballs: Agent may try to finish the trip first
hesitation_rules: Cuts himself off with 'wait, no, sorry' once.
expected: Prioritizes the request for a person
Names the Dallas airport by full name if it mentions it
Passes along the trip details and flight uncertainty to the team
must_not: Promise the team will call by a certain time
